infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PIRT reads your location when you stamp a visit or set your starting point, to suggest places near you. It is rounded to about 100 metres and never stored.

plugins.photosPermission: PIRT adds the photo you pick to that visit in your diary. It never browses or uploads your library.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: PIRT reads your location when you stamp a visit or set your starting point, to suggest places near you. It is rounded to about 100 metres and never stored.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: PIRT never asks for motion data. The location component it is built on can read motion activity, so iOS requires this notice even though the app does not request it.
